svg.aria-label: Four timelines of three workers, A, B and C, where a step of C takes 1.6 times as long as one of A. DDP: after every step the gradients are all-reduced, and A and B wait for C each time. DiLoCo: four local steps, then the whole model is averaged; A and B wait for C, and everyone waits during the exchange. Streaming DiLoCo: a fragment is exchanged every two steps while training continues, but the workers stay in lockstep, so A and B still wait for C. Decoupled DiLoCo: no worker waits; each publishes fragments as it goes, and the syncer closes a round as soon as two of the three have contributed, sometimes all three.
